shared_elements: procession/row of figures arranged along a horizontal register
animals and humans combined in one scene
repetition of similar figures in a line
justification: Both surfaces depict rows of human figures alongside quadrupeds in profile spread along a long horizontal band, which gives a loose arrangement correspondence. But the depicted content differs sharply: A shows a stately procession of robed dignitaries and a horse-drawn chariot with modelled, naturalistic anatomy, drapery and architectural crenellations and rosette borders, while B shows tiny stick-like silhouetted figures with splayed limbs swarming around a single oversized antlered stag and other beasts in an unbounded hunting scene with no framing bands.
